title: Escaping Product Market Rivalry Through Innovation
eligible_reason: Continuous-treatment stacked difference-in-differences. Treatment is SIM_AFTER (firm-level cosine similarity to first-time Chinese entrants, continuous, interacted with AFTER = entry year onward) or NTRG_AFTER (industry tariff gap x AFTER), estimated on a stack of entry-year events with EVENT_FIRM and EVENT_YEAR fixed effects (reghdfe LN_PAT SIM_AFTER ..., abs(EVENT_FIRM EVENT_YEAR) cl(FIRM)); the discrete variant SIM_D_AFTER compares top- versus bottom-tercile similarity firms within each event (DISCRETE==1) and remains stacked with no untreated group. Dynamic figures use c.SIM##i.YEARDIS2 interactions. No binary staggered treatment, no unstacked TWFE; the analysis dataset (main_data.dta) is not shipped.
design_notes: Firm-event-year panel of U.S. electronics/electrical appliance firms around first-time Chinese entry years (five-year windows per the abstract). Table 2: NTRG_AFTER with controls LN_KL LN_RDSTK LN_SALE LN_AGE under FE sets (EVENT FIRM YEAR), (FIRM EVENT_YEAR), (EVENT_FIRM EVENT_YEAR). Table 3: SIM_AFTER analogues; col 5 without controls; cols 6-7 SIM_D_AFTER on DISCRETE==1 (top vs bottom 33% SIM within entry year). Table 4: EVENT_INDUSTRY_YEAR FE, LN_CIT, value-weighted and 2-year variants, single-segment and SIC 367 subsamples. Table 5: SIMEU+ instrument-style two-step (SIM on SIM_EUP, then SIM_AFTER_HAT). Table 6: other outcomes (ROA SALE RD NSIC LN_PAT_NTEC LN_PAT_ETEC SHR_PAT_PRD SHR_PAT_PRC SEF CNF) on SIM_AFTER without controls. Figure 2: c.SIM##i.b4.YEARDIS2 and i.SIM_D##i.b4.YEARDIS2 with controls. Citations of Callaway-Sant'Anna, de Chaisemartin-D'Haultfoeuille and Goodman-Bacon appear in the text only; no such estimator is in the code.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Multiple Chinese entry-year events are stacked (EVENT), but treatment is continuous intensity rather than a binary switch; cohort count not recoverable without the data.

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment (SIM x AFTER) in a stacked event design (EVENT_FIRM, EVENT_YEAR FE)
specs.treatment_definition: firm-entry-year product-description similarity to first-time Chinese entrants x 1(year >= entry year)
specs.controls: none (col 5); LN_KL LN_RDSTK LN_SALE LN_AGE elsewhere

specs.exclusion_reason: binary high- vs low-intensity comparison (top vs bottom SIM tercile) within a stacked design; no untreated units; stacked FE
specs.treatment_definition: SIM_D (top 33% SIM within entry year = 1, bottom 33% = 0) x AFTER
specs.notes: Closest to a binary design but still stacked and intensity based.
